\begin{problem}
Compute $\int_0^1 x^2\,dx$ and $\lim_{n\to\infty} (1 + \frac{1}{n})^n$.
\end{problem}
\begin{solution}
We have
\[ \int_0^1 x^2\,dx = \left[\frac{x^3}{3}\right]_0^1 = \frac{1}{3}. \]
The limit is $e \approx 2.718$.
\end{solution}

\begin{problem}
Let $X \sim \mathcal{N}(\mu, \sigma^2)$. Show that $\Var(aX + b) = a^2 \sigma^2$ for all $a, b \in \mathbb{R}$.
\end{problem}

\begin{problem}
Solve the system
\begin{align*}
  2x + 3y &= 7 \\
  x - y &= 1
\end{align*}
\begin{enumerate}[label=(\alph*)]
  \item Find $x$ and $y$.
  \item Verify that $\abs{x - y} = 1$.
\end{enumerate}
\end{problem}
